text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...I can feel it.
The sound of turning wheels,
solidifying my grand design...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
And so I go forth.
Onto the glorious road lined with crowns, with a run that is mine alone—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Tanino Gimlet really runs with some serious power!
Feels like she's leaped right into the spotlight
as one of the favorites for the Satsuki Sho...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if she's going for the Classic Triple Crown.
I'm already so excited~!

Tanino Gimlet delivered brilliant results from her Junior-class training.
Right after the race, interview requests came flooding in—

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
“—That was a magnificent run today!
It was a performance that surely raises expectations
heading into the spring G1 campaign!”

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh—
This is merely the beginning.
You should anticipate an even deeper intoxication than today.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: Ooh...! Does that mean you're declaring your bid for the Triple Crown route!? Is your next race indeed the Satsuki Sho...!?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh heh, do not be so hasty. Sit and await the hour of revelation. I assure you, it will be far from dull.
...From the reporters' sheer enthusiasm, it was clear that Tanino Gimlet was gathering the people's expectations with this run.
And so, after finishing the interview—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —The time is ripe.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Where is the next place we aim for?
……You know where, don't you?"
"If we sharpen the performance shown today over the remaining time, claiming victory at the NHK Mile Cup is definitely well within reach...!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ――No.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: The next goal I should aim for... is the Satsuki Sho.

It was so shocking I thought my ears were deceiving me.
Yet Tanino Gimlet's eyes,
the spark deep within them, was nothing but sheer seriousness...!
choice_data_list: Our goal is to complete the 'MC Rotation'...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, we should skip the Satsuki Sho
and head straight for the NHK Mile Cup, you say.
Truly rational. There is nothing wrong with that.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —However, that goes against my aesthetic.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...I told you, didn't I, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Not in sunlit tranquility,
but amidst the harshness of looming dark clouds—
that is where my brilliance becomes truly vivid.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
With the way I ran today, I will surely be expected
to take the Classic Triple Crown.
Even though all I did was make them dream of a more ruthless destruction—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: How could I possibly defy the very frenzy I created myself?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Achieving the MC Rotation becomes all the more grueling.
Splendid! It is precisely because I tread the path untrodden that I am Tanino Gimlet!"

—...And precisely because she was Tanino Gimlet,
I felt compelled to support her.
choice_data_list: ...Understood. Your next race is the Satsuki Sho!
...Understood. Your next race will be the Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.text:
And so, with our next target set on the Satsuki Sho,
we took our first step toward the spring GⅠ campaign!
A few days after the Shinzan Kinen—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —Heh, I terrify even myself. What I must do is clearer now than ever before...!
...Lately, Tanino Gimlet had begun showing rapid growth at a pace never seen before.

I knew she harbored tremendous potential from the start—
but even that might have been an underestimation.

Witnessing such marvelous growth had caused
"a certain thought" to surface relentlessly
in my mind as of late.
...Tanino Gimlet might just be an Umamusume capable of achieving feats that surpass even the 'MC Rotation.'
"She might just possess the strength to achieve a tremendous, world-renowned feat."
However, by undertaking the grueling "MC Rotation" that also includes the Satsuki Sho—
"That those brilliant possibilities might end up being chained away, that is."
...I am well aware that everything Tanino Gimlet has is directed toward the 'MC Rotation.'

Therefore, the question I am about to ask
is a final confirmation for myself and for her.
choice_data_list: You could achieve a feat even greater than the MC rotation.
You're capable of achieving feats even greater than the Mile Championship rotation.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...Hooh.
choice_data_list: But you staked everything on the MC rotation
But you staked everything on the MC rotation

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Unwavering as ever, I shall continue
to stake everything upon the Mile Championship rotation and my own aesthetic.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
“If I worry about what comes ‘after,’
these legs will hesitate, and I'll lose my ‘speed.’”

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...The 'MC Rotation' is not something that can be achieved
with such half-baked 'strength.'

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I move forward.
Without hesitation, with an iron will stronger than anyone's.

I already knew the answer.
The final check was just now... complete.

I will no longer question her resolve.
As her Trainer,
all I have to do is run forward without looking aside.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —Those are good eyes.

Starting the next day, in order to provide Tanino Gimlet
with even better care, I began running all over between
my duties in search of new knowledge.
I'll do everything in my power to keep her safe, both before and after she takes on the MC Rotation...!

It felt as though no matter how much time we had,
it would never be enough—
Tanino Gimlet's Satsuki Sho would surely be here before long—
